defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks table merge (birleştirme) — only transfer to empty table
defects.invariant: Waiter must be able to merge two occupied tables' checks into one, matching PosTerminal capability
defects.mechanism: transfer.js openTransferSheet() filters targets to only status==='available' (line 19-20); PosTerminal TableWorkspace.tsx mergeTargets includes both 'Available' and 'Occupied' tables (line 183) and UI offers checkbox list for merge (lines 501-502)
defects.acceptance: WaiterPWA transfer sheet offers merge action with occupied tables as targets, posts to server merge endpoint, and reflects merged state in bill

limitations: Only static code review; runtime server merge endpoint behavior not verified; PosTerminal merge uses onAction callback with mergeGroupId — waiter PWA would need equivalent API
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
